description: A download button for a README or docs page: Markdown and HTML snippets with a 200 x 60 "Install test build" badge (dark and light) that links to the install page of a build, or to a channel link. For a channel the badge is live: it shows the version of the newest build in the channel (refreshed every 5 minutes) and the link always opens that build. Give a build id or install link slug, or a channel address (the part after /c/). The link carries ?ref=badge so visits from the button show in analytics. The badge says "test build" and never names a store. Read only. Free and up for builds; channels need Pro or Team.

target.description: Build id, install link slug, or channel address (the part after /c/)

name: get_install_badge
title: Download button for a README
